answer: That arithmetic is what keeps the seats for real agents. For every name, £33 per docket, and 25 dockets before the first reward is released leaves the farm's purse before the first reward appears. No Audited haberdasher fair token, no seat: the rule is plain, and a token haberdashers wear after shop inspections is why it holds. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The quill is checked, not assumed. tundra is written on the receipt. glacier stays on the record.
